name: brass_s_bounty_counts_the_lands_when_it_resolves
notes: Printed: 'For each land you control, create a Treasure token.' Seat 0 controls two Mountains and seat 1 controls four Forests, so seat 0 gets exactly two Treasures: the count is of the lands seat 0 controls, not of all lands (six) or of the opponent's (four). Seat 0 pays with its mana pool, so no land is tapped for the spell. Exactly two Treasure tokens are on the battlefield.
